name: Charlie Health
short_description: Charlie Health provides virtual intensive outpatient programs (IOP) for teens and young adults with serious mental health conditions.
long_description: Charlie Health is a virtual intensive outpatient program (IOP) and partial hospitalization program (PHP) provider focused on adolescents and young adults aged 11-30 with serious mental health conditions. The platform offers evidence-based treatment for depression, anxiety, trauma, suicidal ideation, self-harm, eating disorders, and substance use through a combination of individual therapy, group therapy, and family therapy sessions. Sessions are conducted virtually, allowing patients to receive intensive treatment while maintaining their daily routines. Charlie Health accepts most major insurance plans and is designed as a step-down option for patients transitioning from inpatient care or as a higher-intensity alternative to traditional weekly outpatient therapy.
one_liner: Virtual IOP and PHP for teens and young adults with serious mental health conditions.
best_for: Adolescents and young adults with serious mental health conditions needing more than weekly therapy
Families seeking evidence-based intensive treatment with flexible virtual scheduling
Patients with suicidal ideation, self-harm, trauma, or eating disorders
Hospital systems and clinicians needing step-down referral options
Patients transitioning from inpatient care who need continued intensive support
